comments.body:
Plan review PASSED (verdict PASS, 0 blocking, 2 advisory) at head_sha ee2c54f881d6, signed.

Advisory f2af906e (COH/E6, triage bucket apply-now) — 'does a raw pytest.importorskip satisfy AC4, or must the fix call a tests/_extra_guard.py helper?'. APPLIED, and the reconciliation is: the raw call IS the sanctioned call. tests/_extra_guard.py exposes no per-test helper API; conftest.py calls _extra_guard.install(), which REBINDS pytest.importorskip itself to strict_importorskip when REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1. So one identical call site gets both sides. Empirically confirmed in this worktree:
  - extra absent, no env var  -> 15 passed, 1 skipped (SKIPPED ... could not import 'hcl2')
  - extra absent, REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1 -> 1 failed, 15 passed, raised from tests/_extra_guard.py:58 as ImportError, NOT a skip
  - extra installed (python-hcl2==8.1.3) -> 16 passed
  - extra installed + REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1 (the true gating-lane config) -> 16 passed
The guard's comment in the test now states this explicitly so the next reader does not re-raise the same question.

Advisory f607dd45 (P6 ac-quality, triage bucket defer, priority 0.40 vs a 0.95 block line) — one AC line bundles two deliverables with 'and' (AC1: guard present AND the other 15 still run). DEFERRED. Rewording the description would change the plan material and invalidate the signed attestation on a bug that is currently reddening main; the substance is verified anyway, both halves demonstrated separately by the runs above. No behavioural gap.

compiled_state.description:
## The gap

`tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py::test_terraform_call_gets_tools_and_finalizer`
hard-requires the OPTIONAL `grounding-terraform` extra (`python-hcl2==8.1.3`) but carries **no
`importorskip` guard**. Every CI lane that deliberately installs without that extra therefore
fails this test.

This is breaking `main` NOW. Run 33905162633 (test.yml on branch main, sha ee2c54f881d6):

```
FAILED tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py::test_terraform_call_gets_tools_and_finalizer
AssertionError: assert 'abstain' == 'refuted'
1 failed, 15435 passed, 92 skipped in 415.78s
```

at `test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py:118`:
```
result = lookup("aws_instance.web", module_path="infra")
assert result["evidence"]["outcome"] == "refuted"   # got 'abstain'
```

## Root cause — VERIFIED by controlled experiment

The install step SUCCEEDS; this is not a resolution failure. `src/rebar/grounding/terraform_tools.py::open_session`
does `if not available(): pending = "missing_extra"`, and every query then returns a closed
ABSTENTION rather than a verdict. `available()` is `_capabilities.is_available("grounding_terraform")`,
whose probe is `hcl2`. So without the extra the tool abstains, and the test asserting `refuted` fails.

Experiment in a throwaway worktree at ee2c54f881d6:
- hcl2 absent -> `1 failed, 15 passed`, identical assertion. Reproduced.
- `uv pip install python-hcl2==8.1.3`, NO other change -> `16 passed`. Confirmed.

## Why it appeared now, and why only on some lanes

`6dde7dffe6b2` ("Add optional Terraform structural grounding") added this test module. Its two
sibling modules from the SAME commit — `tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_tools.py` and
`test_terraform_index.py` — each carry a module-scope `pytest.importorskip("hcl2")`. This module
got none. That inconsistency sat latent.

`c57057f41` ("Enable the grounding-terraform extra") then added `--extra grounding-terraform` to
`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml` (the gating Verified lane) and `_optionality.yml` — but
NOT to `test.yml`. So the gating lane installs the extra and passes, while every `test.yml` sweep
lane installs without it (`uv pip install --resolution lowest-direct '.[dev,agents]'` at line 413;
`.[dev,reviewbot,ui]` at 320/352/380) and fails.

Confirmed in the same run: `build-and-test / pytest (macos-latest, py3.13)` PASSED with
`uv sync --locked ... --extra grounding-terraform` and `+ python-hcl2==8.1.3` in its log, while
`sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` and `sweep (py3.14)` both failed with the byte-identical
assertion.

## Regression, not pre-existing — VERIFIED

`sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` had NEVER failed before this run. Earlier red main-health
runs failed on DIFFERENT jobs:
```
33875177644 (09-04 12:54, 1af450654) success — sweep (windows) only
33846424069 (06:55) failure — sweep (windows), sweep (macos, full suite)
33840948374 (05:33) failure — sweep (windows), scanner-integration
33824556786 (01:07) failure — sweep (windows), pytest (ubuntu, py3.13)
33792688019 (09-03 18:48) success — sweep (windows) only
```
Introduced between `1af450654` (green) and `ee2c54f881d6`.

## Approach

Add a **FUNCTION-SCOPE** `pytest.importorskip("hcl2")` immediately before the real-parse query in
`test_terraform_call_gets_tools_and_finalizer`, just before the `lookup = next(...)` call around
line 117.

**Function scope, not module scope.** This is the only test in the file that needs a real HCL
parse; the other 15 exercise routing, the extra-less contract, and read-set freshness. A
module-scope guard would over-skip and discard exactly the coverage the lean lanes SHOULD keep —
including the tests that verify correct behaviour when the extra is absent, which are the most
valuable ones to run on an extra-less lane.

**Guard the test; do NOT widen the sweep lanes' installs.** The lower-bound lane's own header
states its contract: "The floorless optional web extras (ui/reviewbot/pricing) are out of scope —
their tests self-skip via importorskip". The repo already has the sanctioned TWO-SIDED mechanism
(`tests/_extra_guard.py`, bug 599e-77da-29dd-482d): tests guard with `importorskip`, and the
gating lane sets `REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1` — which DOES install grounding-terraform — so the guard
becomes a hard error there if the extra ever silently disappears. That gives skip-on-lean and
fail-loudly-on-gating from one mechanism. Adding the extra to every sweep lane would instead make
the lean lanes not lean, defeating their purpose.

**No dependency floor should be raised.** `python-hcl2==8.1.3` is an EXACT pin, so there is no
floor to fail. Any floor change here would be aimed at the wrong cause.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1 — `test_terraform_call_gets_tools_and_finalizer` calls `pytest.importorskip("hcl2")`
      before its real-parse query, and the module's other 15 tests still RUN (not skip) without
      the extra installed.
- [ ] AC2 — In an install WITHOUT `grounding-terraform`, `pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py`
      reports `15 passed, 1 skipped`. Demonstrate with actual output.
- [ ] AC3 — In an install WITH the extra, all 16 tests run and pass. Demonstrate with actual output.
- [ ] AC4 — Under the gating lane's configuration (`REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1`), the guard is a HARD
      ERROR rather than a silent skip, so a silently-vanished extra cannot hide as a skip on the
      lane that is supposed to prove it. Verify against `tests/_extra_guard.py`'s existing
      mechanism rather than inventing a second one.

## Non-goals

Not changing `terraform_tools.py`'s abstention behaviour — abstaining without the extra is CORRECT
and is what the other 15 tests pin. Not adding `grounding-terraform` to any `test.yml` sweep lane.
Not raising any dependency floor. Not touching `sweep (windows)`, which is a separate long-standing
failure with its own ticket (`unsuited-locustal-incatern`) blocked on an operator scope decision.

## File impact

`tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py`

file_impact.reason: Add a function-scope pytest.importorskip("hcl2") guard before the real-parse refutation query in test_terraform_call_gets_tools_and_finalizer.
